title: Big slice, deep engagement
description: angle = share of users · radius = minutes per day · dotted rings at 15 / 30 / 45 min

props.name: data
props.description: Surfaces with percent shares and nonnegative daily minutes. Complete shares must total 100; missing minutes retain the angular allocation and an unavailable label. Slices sort by share; tone ranks minutes.

props.name: scaleMinutes
props.description: Positive finite outer reference scale in minutes. The scale expands when a supplied observation exceeds it.

props.name: referenceMinutes
props.description: Caller-owned dashed reference rings in minutes. Invalid or out-of-scale values are omitted.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot proportions.

props.name: width
props.description: Optional fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills its containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the component container.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
